title: A sequential linear complementarity problem method for generalized Nash equilibrium problems
summary: Generalized Nash equilibrium problems (GNEPs) arise in various applications where multiple players minimize individual cost functions subject to coupled constraints. A relatively unexplored approach to solving such problems is via a sequence of (mixed) linear complementarity problems (LCPs). Compared with the nonlinear equilibrium subproblems arising in recently popular penalty-based methods such as augmented Lagrangian methods, these LCPs are often substantially easier to solve.
